cells.title: Add Paseo workspace helpers and drop agent-scope env from every paseo child
cells.action: In herding/paseo.rs add, as pub items: (a) `AGENT_SCOPE_VARS: [&str; 2] = ["PASEO_AGENT_ID", "PASEO_AGENT_CWD"]`. (b) `inside_paseo() -> bool` per D1: true when PASEO_AGENT_ID or PASEO_CLI is set and non-empty; under cfg(test) it reads a thread_local seam that defaults to false (same pattern as TEST_DISCOVERY at the top of the file) plus a cfg(test) setter `set_inside_paseo_for_test(bool)`. (c) `first_json_document(stdout: &str) -> Option<Value>` per D6: pull the existing scan out of `parse_run_agent_id` (paseo.rs:219-233; the same loop repeats near lines 265, 351, 486, 503, 622) into this one helper, start at `{` OR `[`, and keep the skip-a-failed-parse-and-continue behavior so `[login-shell-env] {` noise is skipped; make `parse_run_agent_id` use it with unchanged results (switch the other copies only where results stay identical). (d) argv builders `workspace_ls_argv()` = [workspace, ls, --json], `project_ls_argv()` = [project, ls, --json], `workspace_create_argv(path: &str, project: Option<&str>)` = [workspace, create, --path, <path>, --isolation, local, (--project, <id>), --json], `workspace_archive_argv(id)` = [workspace, archive, <id>, --json] (do not reuse `archive_argv`, which archives an agent). (e) Path compare: use `crate::path_identity::canonical_paths_equal` (path_identity.rs:200); add no new compare helper. (f) `ensure_workspace(cli: &dyn PaseoCli, main_root: &Path, dir: &Path) -> Result<String, String>` per D2: call workspace ls; if an array row has `cwd` equal to `dir` by canonical_paths_equal, return its `workspaceId`; else call project ls and take the `projectId` whose `path` equals main_root (None when no match); call workspace create; return the `workspaceId` of the first JSON document; every failure is Err carrying paseo's own error text (`error.message` of a JSON error object when present, else the raw text). (g) `archive_workspace(cli: &dyn PaseoCli, id: &str) -> Result<(), String>`. D5, all spawners: in `run_with_deadline` and the no-timeout branch of `RealPaseoCli::call` (paseo.rs), in `RealWaitSource::arm` (run.rs, `Command::new(&self.command)` near line 4093), in `RealSteerRunner::steer` (paseo_steer.rs:108) and in `run_probe_command_bounded` (verbs/drivers/prepare.rs:3110), `env_remove` each AGENT_SCOPE_VARS entry. D5 worker env: in run.rs `execute_paseo`, the block that turns `child_env` into `env_pairs` (near line 3556) — extract a small pub(crate) fn `paseo_env_pairs(child_env: BTreeMap<String,String>) -> Vec<(String,String)>` that drops AGENT_SCOPE_VARS keys, and use it there. Unit tests: first_json_document skips multi-line `[login-shell-env] {` noise and plain log lines and returns an object or an array; parse_run_agent_id results unchanged; ensure_workspace reuses a ls row whose cwd is a symlink of dir (temp dir + std::os::unix::fs::symlink under cfg(unix)); ensure_workspace creates with --project <id> when project ls matches main_root and without --project when none matches; ensure_workspace returns Err with paseo's message on a create error object; argv shapes; paseo_env_pairs drops both vars and keeps others; RealPaseoCli on `sh -c 'echo ${PASEO_AGENT_ID:-absent}'` (or equivalent) with PASEO_AGENT_ID set in the process env prints absent — any test that sets or reads process env vars holds `crate::hooks::herding_env_lock()` (hooks/mod.rs:123) and restores the env after. No test calls a real paseo binary. No code comments.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee herding:: && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee prepare

truths: ensure_workspace reuses an existing workspace whose cwd is the same directory through a symlink
ensure_workspace passes --project <projectId> of the main checkout, and omits --project when none matches
first_json_document reads a JSON object or array after wrapper log lines, and parse_run_agent_id is unchanged
a paseo child process does not see PASEO_AGENT_ID or PASEO_AGENT_CWD (runner, wait source, steer runner, prepare probe)
inside_paseo is false in unit tests unless the seam sets it
paseo_env_pairs carries neither agent-scope variable

cells.title: Register worktrees as Paseo workspaces and archive them on teardown
cells.action: (1) workspace_store.rs: add `set_paseo_workspace_id(root, id, paseo_id) -> W<()>` that takes the workspace lock, reads the record (read_workspace_record), inserts `paseo_workspace_id`, writes atomically; and `record_for_dir(root, dir) -> Option<Map<String, Value>>` returning the record from list_workspaces whose `root` equals `dir` or is an ancestor of it (canonicalize both with std::fs::canonicalize, fall back to the raw path, then Path::starts_with; the longest root wins). (2) New verbs/worktree/paseo_ws.rs, declared in mod.rs, the ONE home for ensure-and-record: `ensure_and_record(cli: &dyn PaseoCli, main_root, dir) -> Result<String, String>`: a record_for_dir record with a non-empty `paseo_workspace_id` returns it with no paseo call; else herding::paseo::ensure_workspace, then set_paseo_workspace_id when a record matched; returns the id. `real_cli(main_root)` builds `RealPaseoCli::new(paseo_command(&read_main_config(main_root))).with_timeout(8 s)`. `register(main_root, worktree_root) -> Option<Value>`: None when `!herding::paseo::inside_paseo()`; else prints `▸ paseo: registering workspace…` on stderr and returns Some({"id": <wks>}) or Some({"error": <text>}) from ensure_and_record with the real CLI. `archive_with_cli(cli, main_root, id)` reads the record; when it carries a non-empty `paseo_workspace_id` it calls archive_workspace and prints one stderr line `paseo: archived workspace <wks>` or `paseo: could not archive workspace <wks>: <error> — FIX: paseo workspace archive <wks>`; `archive(main_root, id)` builds the real CLI only when the record carries an id (D3: no inside_paseo check). (3) create.rs: `Created` gains `paseo_workspace: Option<Value>`; post_add sets None; `create_feature_worktree` calls paseo_ws::register AFTER `guard.release()` on Ok and stores the value; fix the two hand-built `Created { … }` in tests.rs (near lines 699 and 736). (4) handlers.rs `new_result_and_text`: when Some, JSON gets key `paseoWorkspace` (camelCase like `worktreeRoot`) with the value, and text gains a line `  paseo:       workspace <wks>` or `  paseo:       workspace not registered — <error>`; when None the JSON and text stay byte-identical to today. (5) merge.rs `teardown_worktree`: call paseo_ws::archive(main_root, id) immediately before `ws::unregister_workspace(main_root, id)`. Tests (in paseo_ws.rs and tests.rs; fake PaseoCli only): set_paseo_workspace_id round trip; record_for_dir finds the record for a subdirectory of its root; ensure_and_record records the id from a fake create; ensure_and_record makes no call when the record already has an id; on a create error it returns Err and the record has no field; register returns None outside Paseo (default seam); archive_with_cli calls `workspace archive <wks> --json` when the record has the id and makes no call when it does not; new_result_and_text with None, Some(id), Some(error). A test that seeds a record with `paseo_workspace_id` calls archive_with_cli and NEVER teardown_worktree or merge/prune, so no test reaches a real daemon. Existing worktree tests stay green. No code comments.

cells.title: Start Paseo workers in their worktree's workspace
cells.action: (1) paseo.rs `run_argv` gains `workspace: Option<&str>`; when Some, push `--workspace <id>` right before `--cwd`. Update every caller (run.rs spawn site and the paseo.rs tests; existing tests pass None and keep their expected argv). (2) run.rs `execute_paseo` (near line 3420), after the version check and before run_argv: resolve the workspace per D4 with pw-2's single path — call `crate::verbs::worktree::paseo_ws::ensure_and_record(cli, &opts.main_root, &opts.cwd)` when `paseo::inside_paseo()` is true, or when `record_for_dir` finds a record that already carries `paseo_workspace_id` (that id then comes back with no paseo call). Outside Paseo with no recorded id pass None. An Err inside Paseo returns `RunOutcome::SpawnFailed(format!("paseo workspace for {cwd} could not be found or created: {err} — FIX: paseo workspace create --path {cwd} --isolation local, then re-run"))` before any `paseo run` call (D4: never the caller workspace). Make paseo_ws / ensure_and_record pub(crate) as needed. Tests (run.rs, fake PaseoCli that records argv as existing paseo spawn tests do; set the D1 seam with paseo::set_inside_paseo_for_test and reset it): a recorded id yields `--workspace <id>` in the run argv with no ls/create call; inside Paseo with no record, ensure is called and its id used; inside Paseo with ensure failing, the run is SpawnFailed naming the FIX and no `run` argv was called; outside Paseo with no record, argv has no `--workspace`. No code comments.

truths: a Paseo run from a worktree with a recorded id passes --workspace <id>
inside Paseo with no id the run ensures one or refuses before spawn with a paseo FIX line
outside Paseo with no id the argv is unchanged
